name: Nexu StepFun Realtime Voice
description: Registers StepFun (阶跃星辰) StepAudio 3 Realtime as an OpenClaw realtime voice provider so Talk sessions can run full-duplex Chinese speech conversations.

apiKey.description: StepFun API key. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

model.description: Realtime model id. Defaults to stepaudio-3-realtime-preview.

voice.description: Voice id. Official voices or a cloned voice id.

serverVad.description: Enable StepFun server-side VAD (default true). Server VAD is what makes barge-in work.
